L1.description: Torras i Bages: From 05/08/2026, the access Passeig Santa Coloma / costat muntanya of the Torras i Bages station (L1) is closed for works. · Plaça de Sants: Until approximately March 27, 2027, the passageway between L1 and L5 at Plaça de Sants station will be closed due to improvement work.

L2.description: Monumental: Until September 29th, approximately, the last section of escalators going up from the Badalona Pompeu Fabra's plattform to the lobby at Monumental station, out of service due to maintenance works. · Verneda: Until September 29th, approximately, the elevator connecting the lobby and the plattform direction Badalona Pompeu Fabra, at Verneda station, out of service due to maintenance works.

L3.description: Roquetes: Until 25/10/2026, the escalators from the lobby to the entrance Jaume Pinent, of Roquetes station (L3) temporarily out of service. · Sants Estació: Until approximately September 10th, the escalator that goes down from the main lobby to the lower lobby of Sants Estació station will be out of service due to improvement work.

L4.description: Verdaguer: Until 01/02/2027, the escalator from the platform direction La Pau to the lobby of the Verdaguer station (L4) temporarily out of service. · Verdaguer: Until 01/02/2027, the escalator from the platform direction Trinitat Nova to the lobby of the Verdaguer station (L4) temporarily out of service.

L5.description: Badal: Until September 17, approximately, the escalator going down from the main lobby to the middle lobby at Badal station, out of order due to improvement works. · Badal: Until September 17, approximately, the escalator going up from the middle lobby to the main lobby at Badal station, out of order due to improvement works.
